description.value: A Bread Affair – Langley is the production heart of this organic artisan bakery chain, where every loaf is hand-shaped using slow fermentation and locally sourced BC ingredients. The Langley location doubles as a full-service café, offering fresh-baked sourdough and pastries alongside quality coffee — a tucked-away stop on the Langley Bypass between Kal-Tire and the Toyota dealership. Cyclists looking to resupply with artisan bread or refuel with a warm pastry and espresso will find a welcoming, independently minded spot here.

address.value: 20560 Langley Bypass, Unit 309, Langley, BC V3A 6K8
